reports.title: Файлы CSV
reports.query: SELECT file_name, measured_date, series, seq FROM co_file ORDER BY measured_date, series, seq, file_name

reports.title: Содержимое CSV
reports.query: SELECT sample_time, channel_a, step_value, channel_b, flag_value FROM co_preview

source.body: {"steps":[{"type":"selectOne","var":"file","sql":"SELECT file_name, source_path FROM co_file WHERE file_name = ?","params":["${input.file_name}"]},{"type":"failIfNull","var":"file","error_code":"NOT_FOUND","error_message":"Файл не найден в каталоге"},{"type":"exec","sql":"DELETE FROM co_open"},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO co_open (id, file_name, source_path) VALUES (1, ?, ?)","params":["${file.file_name}","${file.source_path}"]},{"type":"exec","sql":"DELETE FROM co_preview"},{"type":"exec","sql":"INSERT INTO co_preview (sample_time, channel_a, step_value, channel_b, flag_value) SELECT * FROM CSVREAD((SELECT source_path FROM co_open WHERE id = 1), null, 'charset=UTF-8 fieldSeparator=;')"},{"type":"return","fields":{"error_code":"OK","error_message":"","file_name":"${file.file_name}"}}]}
